widgets: 

**The "Illumined Divines" Named in the Kitáb-i-Íqán**

Each row below rests on a passage that describes the man, not on the Íqán list that merely names him.

| # | Name | Who he was | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Mullá Ḥusayn** (Bushrúyih) | First of the Letters of the Living. He led the Bábís to Fort Ṭabarsí and was shot there by ‘Abbás-Qulí Khán, then buried in the fort. Bahá'u'lláh revealed a Tablet of Visitation for him. He was the hero of the Nayríz upheaval in Fárs and fell as a victim of its flames. | ([bab-kutob-03-1-2-en-notes](https://oceanoflights.org/file/bab-kutob-03-1-2-en-notes.pdf); [God Passes By](https://oceanlibrary.com/god-passes-by_shoghi-effendi/?paraId=para_107&selectionString=god_passes_by_ocean_en_5q.0~god_passes_by_ocean_en_5q.1544)) |
| 3 | **Mullá Muḥammad-‘Alíy-i-Zanjání** (Ḥujjat) | A Zanján mujtahid. On reading the Báb's writings he abandoned his lecture-room and called his disciples to the Báb. | ([A Traveler’s Narrative](https://oceanlibrary.com/travelers-narrative_abdul-baha/?paraId=para_15&selectionString=abdu-l-baha-traveler-s-narrative-ocean_en_36.0~abdu-l-baha-traveler-s-narrative-ocean_en_36.282); [God Passes By](https://oceanlibrary.com/god-passes-by_shoghi-effendi/?paraId=para_42&selectionString=god_passes_by_ocean_en_3x.0~god_passes_by_ocean_en_3x.897)) |
| 4 | **Mullá ‘Alíy-i-Basṭámí** | A Letter of the Living. He proclaimed the Báb before Shaykh Muḥammad-Ḥasan in Najaf and was then excommunicated, chained and imprisoned. Shoghi Effendi calls him "the first to suffer" for the Báb. Balyuzi calls him the first Bábí martyr. | ([God Passes By](https://oceanlibrary.com/god-passes-by_shoghi-effendi/?paraId=para_39&selectionString=god_passes_by_ocean_en_3u.0~god_passes_by_ocean_en_3u.1230)); Balyuzi, *The Báb* |
| 5 | **Mullá Sa‘íd-i-Bárfurúshí** | Not identified in the library (searched: Mullá Sa‘íd-i-Bárfurúshí, Mulla Said Barfurushi, Sa‘íd Bárfurúsh with Ṭabarsí, Mázindarán). Fáḍil Mázandarání writes of a Mullá Sa‘íd's cruelty toward Quddús at Bárfurúsh. That is a hostile mullá, and nothing shows he is the same man. | Mázandarání, *Ẓuhúru'l-Ḥaqq* vol. 3 |
| 6 | **Mullá Ni‘matu'lláh-i-Mázindarání** | A Bábí believer martyred at Shaykh Ṭabarsí, according to the glossary of the Spanish edition. | ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all)) |
| 7 | **Mullá Yúsuf-i-Ardibílí** | A Letter of the Living, noted for learning, enthusiasm and eloquence. In Kirmán his eloquence alarmed Ḥájí Karím Khán. | ([The Dawn-Breakers](https://oceanoflights.org/shoghi-effendi-trans-011-the-dawn-breakers-en/#:~:text=149.%20Mull%C3%A1%20Y%C3%BAs%C3%BAf%2Di%2DArdib%C3%ADl%C3%AD%2C%20one,the%20battle%20of%20Vas%2DKas)) |
| 8 | **Mullá Mihdíy-i-Khu'í** | The Spanish glossary calls him a close companion of Bahá'u'lláh and tutor to the children of His household, martyred at Ṭabarsí. That wording matches Shoghi Effendi's note on Mullá Mihdíy-i-Kandí, so treat it as unsettled. Nabíl notes a Letter of the Living, Mullá Maḥmúd-i-Khú'í, as brother of a Mullá Mihdí. | ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all); [The Dawn-Breakers](https://oceanoflights.org/shoghi-effendi-trans-011-the-dawn-breakers-en/#:~:text=148.%20Mull%C3%A1%20Ma%E1%B8%A5m%C3%BAd%2Di%2DKh%C3%BA%E2%80%99%C3%AD%2C%20brother,and%20a%20distinguished%20divine)) |
| 9 | **Siyyid Ḥusayn-i-Turshízí** | Not identified in the library (searched: Turshízí, Siyyid Ḥusayn-i-Turshízí, Turshiz). The Báb's amanuensis was Siyyid Ḥusayn-i-Yazdí, called ‘Azíz, a different man. | ([God Passes By](https://oceanlibrary.com/god-passes-by_shoghi-effendi/?paraId=para_169&selectionString=god_passes_by_ocean_en_7g.0~god_passes_by_ocean_en_7g.803)) |
| 10 | **Mullá Mihdíy-i-Kandí** | A close companion of Bahá'u'lláh and tutor to the children of His household. | ([The Dawn-Breakers](https://oceanoflights.org/shoghi-effendi-trans-011-the-dawn-breakers-en/#:~:text=152.%20Mull%C3%A1%20Mihd%C3%ADy%2Di%2DKand%C3%AD%2C%20a,children%20of%20His%20household)) |
| 11 | **Mullá Báqir** (-i-Kandí) | Brother of Mullá Mihdíy-i-Kandí, not the Letter of the Living of the same name, who lived to recognize Bahá'u'lláh. Like his brother he was one of the defenders of Fort Ṭabarsí. The Spanish glossary records him as martyred there. | ([The Dawn-Breakers](https://oceanoflights.org/shoghi-effendi-trans-011-the-dawn-breakers-en/); [Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all)) |
| 12 | **Mullá ‘Abdu'l-Kháliq-i-Yazdí** | Formerly a Jewish priest. He accepted Islám, joined the Shaykhí school, and was converted by Mullá Ḥusayn, per the Spanish glossary. The Báb addressed a tablet to him. | ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=3); [all items by The Báb, summary](https://bahai-library.com/inventory/BB)) |
| 13 | **Mullá ‘Alíy-i-Baraqání** | A Qazvín cleric from the village of Baraghan, brother of Mullá Taqí and Mullá Ṣáliḥ and so uncle of Ṭáhirih, according to Ruhe. Ruhe writes that he became a follower of Siyyid Káẓim of Rasht. The Spanish glossary adds that he became one of the most active Bábí expositors in Ṭihrán. | Ruhe, *Robe of Light*; ([Libro de Certeza](https://bahai-library.com/bahaullah_libro_certeza_iqan&chapter=all)) |

**Notes on reliability**
- Mullá Sa‘íd-i-Bárfurúshí (5) and Siyyid Ḥusayn-i-Turshízí (9) remain unidentified in the library.
- Rows 6, 8, 11, 12 and the Ṭihrán detail in 13 rest on the notes of a published Spanish glossary, not on Bahá'u'lláh's words. Check them against the Íqán's English notes before citing in a paper.
- For row 11, the library holds no passage describing this Mullá Báqir's own death. The martyrdom claim rests on the glossary, and the Dawn-Breakers passage shows him only inside the fort with his brother. The separation from the Letter of the Living Mullá Muḥammad-Báqir-i-Tabrízí rests on the Íqán's pairing of the two brothers, not on a passage naming him.
- For row 13, the family tie to Ṭáhirih comes from Ruhe and the glossary. ‘Abdu'l-Bahá's *Memorials of the Faithful* names her uncle Mullá Taqí as the Qazvín Imám-Jum‘ih ([Memorials of the Faithful](https://oceanlibrary.com/memorials-of-the-faithful_abdul-baha/?paraId=para_684&selectionString=abdu-l-baha-memorials-of-the-faithful_en_no.0~abdu-l-baha-memorials-of-the-faithful_en_no.482)).
